mapper.sql: FROM ( SELECT c.*, CASE WHEN c.commercial_start_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0, c.commercial_candidate - CASE WHEN DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR) < TIMESTAMPADD(MONTH, c.commercial_candidate * #{cycleMonths} - 1, c.commercial_start_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END AS commercial_active_cycle, CASE WHEN c.compulsory_start_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0, c.compulsory_candidate - CASE WHEN DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR) < TIMESTAMPADD(MONTH, c.compulsory_candidate * #{cycleMonths} - 1, c.compulsory_start_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END AS compulsory_active_cycle FROM ( SELECT d.*, GREATEST(1, FLOOR((PERIOD_DIFF(EXTRACT(YEAR_MONTH FROM DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR)), EXTRACT(YEAR_MONTH FROM d.commercial_start_date)) + 1) / #{cycleMonths})) AS commercial_candidate, GREATEST(1, FLOOR((PERIOD_DIFF(EXTRACT(YEAR_MONTH FROM DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR)), EXTRACT(YEAR_MONTH FROM d.compulsory_start_date)) + 1) / #{cycleMonths})) AS compulsory_candidate FROM ( SELECT rw.*, DATE(DATE_ADD('1970-01-01', INTERVAL (rw.commercial_insurance_start_time + 28800) SECOND)) AS commercial_start_date, DATE(DATE_ADD('1970-01-01', INTERVAL (rw.compulsory_insurance_start_time + 28800) SECOND)) AS compulsory_start_date FROM biz_workorder rw ) d ) c ) w

choose.otherwise: ((w.commercial_active_cycle > 0 AND w.commercial_renewal_cycle >= w.commercial_active_cycle AND w.commercial_renewal_status = #{remindStatus}) OR (w.compulsory_active_cycle > 0 AND w.compulsory_renewal_cycle >= w.compulsory_active_cycle AND w.compulsory_renewal_status = #{remindStatus}))
